comment: integration suite - stands up a real tickerplant and a real hdb as separate q processes
and drives the whole di.rdb lifecycle over genuine IPC: startup, waitfortype, subscribe,
log replay, live capture, the tickerplant's endofday broadcast, savedown and hdb reload.
kept separate because moduletest only ever loads test.csv, so leaving these rows there
would make every unit run spawn two processes and bind two ports.
RUN IT IN A FRESH q SESSION: after moduletest the unit rows are still loaded and KUrt
would re-run them against dirty module state, reporting phantom failures.
needs a q binary reachable via QHOME - both peers are launched with $QHOME/bin/q
